THE EXPERIENCE

Defend an ancient sanctuary from waves of spectral creatures. Your mage casts glowing spells automatically toward your pointer. Defeat shadows to unlock harder waves, and collect golden drops to heal.

HOW TO PLAY

Move with W A S D or arrow keys. Aim spells with the mouse or touch; casting is automatic. Tap Space, Shift or DASH to evade. Press P to pause.

Moonlit Grove FAQ

How do you play Moonlit Grove?

Move through the enchanted grove, aim with the mouse or touch, cast automatic spells and dash away from shadow enemies.

Is Moonlit Grove free?

Yes, it runs entirely in your browser with no installation.
